# G10 Fulfillment

G10 Fulfillment is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. G10 Fulfillment is a logistics company that offers e-commerce fulfillment, retail fulfillment, hazmat fulfillment, wholesale fulfillment, and same day shipping services. They provide custom capabilities and integrations, as well as channelpoint and edi solutions. G10 Fulfillment employs 93 people (+22.4% YoY, +17 people), founded in 2009. Headquartered in Delavan, Wisconsin, United States, with offices in Twin Lakes, Phoenix, Summerville, Sparks, and Tolleson.

## About

At G10 Fulfillment, we help growing brands scale smarter.

With over 1.5 million sq. ft. of warehouse space and a presence across key U.S. markets, G10 offers a full suite of fulfillment services designed to support both DTC and B2B operations. From Amazon FBA prep and retail fulfillment to wholesale distribution and custom kitting, we provide the infrastructure, technology, and hands-on support to help you streamline logistics and exceed customer expectations.

results.title: G10 Platform
results.text:
# G10 Platform

G10 Platform is a Wholesale Building Materials company. G10 Platform is Victoria's builder delivery platform, offering a four-step process for single tenders, project-managed, coordinated site, and lock-up. They have three sister brands under one site: M10 Truss, F1 Steel, and Nova Jones. The platform provides coverage for eight project types, including single dwellings to apartment low-rise. G10 Platform employs 2 people, founded in 2011. Headquartered in Pakenham, Victoria, Australia.

## About

G10 Platform brings together three Victorian businesses — M10 Truss, F1 Steel and Nova Jones — so builders can price and programme the whole building envelope once.

Timber frames and trusses, manufactured in-house with our own detailing team. Structural steel, designed, fabricated and erected by our own crew. External cladding and façade, supplied and installed — including authorised James Hardie Gravis AAC distribution, plus Hebel, Cemintel, Weathertex, Acratex and Unitex systems.

One tender. One purchase order. One site project manager sequencing all three trades to your programme.

Most builders coordinate frame, steel and façade as three separate supply chains — three scopes, three lead times, three sets of exclusions. Every gap between them is programme risk, and it lands on the builder. G10 removes those interfaces by pricing and delivering the envelope as one package, from frame to lock-up.

Send us a drawing set and you will have one priced envelope — frame, steel and cladding — within four to five working days.

WHO WE WORK WITH
Builders and developers delivering townhouses, walk-up apartments and medium-density residential, plus childcare, schools, aged care, medical centres, retail and light commercial. Domestic and commercial construction to four storeys, across Melbourne metro and greater Victoria.

WHY BUILDERS USE US
- Supply and install with our own crews, not a referral network
- We manufacture and fabricate, so lead times and variations stay under our control
- One site project manager holding the sequence across all three trades
- NCC 2025 detailing, including ventilated cavity and façade requirements for Victorian climate zone 6
- A single point of responsibility from frame through to lock-up
